items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a morphism of ringed topoi pulls strictly perfect complexes back to strictly perfect complexes (statement lines 11754-11762). The proof is a termwise reduction: strict perfection is a termwise condition on direct summands of finite free modules, the cited result from Modules on Sites supplies finiteness of the pullback of a finite free module, and additivity of the pullback supplies preservation of direct summands (proof lines 11765-11768). The content is the recognition that both ingredients combine termwise. The claim is H2: one termwise reduction with two named inputs.
